title: payment.failed.v1
description: A payment reached the terminal state FAILED. Published by Payment Orchestration (BC-6) on pp.payments.payment.v1, keyed by payment_id. Note what this event does NOT represent: a gateway timeout. A timed-out call leaves the payment in PROCESSING with a TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN attempt and produces payment.reconciliation_required.v1, because we do not know whether money moved and no timer may decide that it did not.

attemptId.description: Absent for pre-flight rejections, where no attempt was ever created.

failureStage.description: Where in the request pipeline the payment died. This is the field an on-call engineer reads first: it separates 'our validation refused it' from 'the gateway refused it' without a trace lookup.

declineReasonCode.description: Normalized decline reason, never the gateway's raw string.

declineIsRetryable.description: Whether another gateway could plausibly have succeeded. False means a hard decline and no failover was attempted, deliberately.

attemptsMade.description: How many gateways were tried before giving up. Zero for a pre-flight rejection.

terminal.description: Always true - FAILED is terminal. Present so a consumer never has to infer terminality from a state name it may not recognise.
